data.long_meaning: From the Greek ‘Iarbe’, meaning ‘to protect, preserve, or heal’. Jarv can be understood as a name of divine protection or as a reminder of God's constant care for his children. The name Jarv carries the meaning “God's protection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jarv usually hope their child will grow to embody god's protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
